headline: Brazil industrial production declines for second consecutive month
summary: Brazil's industrial production fell by 0.8% in September compared to August, marking the second straight month of decline. The result was worse than market expectations, signaling a cooling of the economy.
why: Industrial production is a key indicator of economic health in Brazil. Sustained declines can signal a broader economic slowdown, impacting GDP forecasts and central bank policy.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Weak industrial data suggests a cooling economy.
